about.heading: Ghana's Premier IT Solutions Company
paragraphs: TechPhase Solutions was founded in Ghana We supply computers and accessories, various office consumables, as well as networking and system maintenance services for a wide range of organizations across Ghana.

We have an excellent track record of successful projects delivered in demanding environments. TechPhase combines best-of-breed technologies to build solutions driven by the ambition to make our clients more successful and help them accomplish their strategic goals.
We serve corporate customers, Government agencies, Educational institutions, and private consumers.
about.mission: Deliver maximum value by supplying quality, affordable, and durable IT products with exceptional after-sales service and networking support.
about.vision: Become the market leader in computer hardware, office supplies, and networking solutions in Ghana and beyond West Africa.

services.subtitle: A comprehensive range of IT services to meet all your technological needs, backed by our commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction.

items.title: Web Development
items.text: Professional website design and development for businesses — from landing pages to full web applications tailored to your needs.

items.title: Professional Email
items.text: Professional business email setup, configuration, and management — including domain-based email hosting, migrations, and ongoing support.

items.title: Cloud Services
items.text: Cloud infrastructure setup, migration, and management to keep your business data secure, accessible, and always available.

items.title: System Administration
items.text: Expert management and administration of servers, networks, and IT infrastructure to ensure optimal uptime and performance.

items.title: Wide Area Networking (WAN)
items.text: Professional installation and maintenance of Wide Area Networks for businesses of all sizes across Ghana.

items.title: Local Area Networking (LAN)
items.text: We plan, design, and maintain Local Area Networks to improve your business efficiency and connectivity.

items.title: Systems Maintenance
items.text: Regular preventive and corrective maintenance to keep your IT systems running at peak performance always.

items.title: CCTV Installations
items.text: Professional CCTV installation and maintenance for enhanced security of your premises and assets.

items.title: Repairs & Servicing
items.text: Expert repairs and servicing of computers, Printers,etc.

items.title: Electric Fence Installation
items.text: Professional installation and commissioning of electric fences for enhanced perimeter security.

items.title: Printing Services
items.text: All printing works including banners, stickers, books, forms, calendars, invoices, and more.

faqs.q: Do you serve clients outside Accra?
faqs.a: Yes. While our office is in Akweteman-Achimota, Accra, we deliver and support projects nationwide, including hospitals and businesses in the Ashanti, Western, and Volta regions.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a support request?
faqs.a: For clients in Greater Accra we typically respond same-day, and within 24 hours for most other regions. Clients on a maintenance contract get priority scheduling.
Yes. We offer monthly, quarterly, and annual preventive maintenance agreements covering computers, networks, CCTV, printers, and UPS systems, tailored to the size of your organization.

faqs.q: Can you supply equipment on a proforma invoice basis?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Send us your requirements by email or through the form above and we will issue a proforma invoice, usually within one business day.

faqs.q: Do your installations come with a warranty?
faqs.a: All hardware carries the manufacturer's warranty, and our workmanship on networking, CCTV, and electric fence installations is covered by our own service guarantee.
